geni_spi_isr()

The interrupt handler got the lock on the spi_geni_set_cs() function,
but then it also got the lock on the geni_spi_isr() function.  This
wasn't allowed because the geni_spi_isr() function had already called
wait_for_completion_timeout().  So the geni_spi_isr() function could
not get the lock on the spi_geni_set_cs() function anymore.

This is fixed by adding a check for the spi_geni_set_cs() function
holding the lock before calling geni_spi_isr(), so that the geni_spi_isr()
function can only call the spi_geni_set_cs() function if it holds the
lock.
